name: After Death
overview: Scripture reveals that after death, the soul continues to exist and faces eternal destiny, emphasizing the reality of both life and judgment beyond the grave. Believers are assured of everlasting life through faith in Christ, who alone has ascended to heaven and offers salvation, while the wicked face destruction and everlasting punishment. The body may perish, but the soul's eternal state is of utmost importance, calling believers to fear God rather than mere physical death.
